# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Polish arms export consent and exact buyer-funded settlement.
# Generated by pol_arms.py, a supplement to the original approved design.

COLDWAR_POL_arms_cash_bonus = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_POL_debt_m5_tt
	hidden_effect = { set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_POL_debt_change = -5 } COLDWAR_POL_change_debt = yes }
	custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_POL_economy_modifier }
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_POL_eco_receiving_investment_cost_modifier = 0.05 tooltip = receiving_investment_cost_modifier_tt }
	newline = yes
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_POL_tension_p2_tt
	hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_tension } set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 2 } mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes } }
}

COLDWAR_POL_arms_cash_accept = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_POL_arms_cash_can_accept = yes }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_POL_arms_cash_paid_amount = { value = gdp_total multiply = 0.01 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_arms_cash_accepted
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_arms_cash_pending
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = { value = COLDWAR_POL_arms_cash_paid_amount multiply = -1 } }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		POL = {
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = ROOT.COLDWAR_POL_arms_cash_paid_amount }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			send_equipment = { type = infantry_weapons_type amount = 1000 target = ROOT }
			send_equipment = { type = medium_tank_chassis amount = 50 target = ROOT }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_arms_cash_bonus_paid } }
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_arms_cash_bonus_paid
				COLDWAR_POL_arms_cash_bonus = yes
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_arms_cash_pending NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_arms_cash_accepted } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_arms_cash_refused } }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_arms_cash_pending
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_arms_cash_expired
	}
}

COLDWAR_POL_arms_friends_bonus = {
	set_temp_variable = { temp_opinion = 10 }
	change_the_military_opinion = yes
	custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_POL_economy_modifier }
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_POL_eco_trade_opinion_factor = -0.03 tooltip = trade_opinion_factor_tt }
	newline = yes
	custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_POL_army_modifier }
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_POL_mil_military_factories_productivity = 0.05 tooltip = military_factories_productivity_tt }
	newline = yes
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_POL_tension_p1_tt
	hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_tension } set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 1 } mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes } }
}
